Read-only review of PR #1 (`git diff main...HEAD`). The unit tests for vectors (`go test -tags unit -run 'Vector|LongType'`) pass, and I found no bug in the bound itself. There is no `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md` and no separate spec. The PR body is the spec, so I did the review inline and did not spawn the two sub-agents.

## Standards
I found no `CODING_STANDARDS.md`. The only repo standard I saw was `CONTRIBUTING.md`, which the diff doesn't breach. Everything below is a judgement call.

1. **Low** — PR body, last line: it ends with "🤖 Generated with [Claude Code]…". Your global CLAUDE.md forbids that attribution in PR descriptions. This is the PR text only, not a code change.
2. **Low** — `marshal_vector_test.go`, `makeVectorType` (new): possible Duplicated Code. It sits next to the existing `makeFloat32VectorType` and `makeDoubleVectorType`, which build the same `VectorType{NativeType{TypeCustom, custom: …}}` shape.
3. **Low** — `marshal_vector_test.go`, `TestUnmarshalVectorZeroDimensionsDoesNotTouchSubType`: the doc comment starts with "VectorType, SubType and…" instead of the function name, unlike the other new tests.
4. **Low** — `helpers.go:277-283`: possible Data Clumps / Mysterious Name. `getApacheCassandraType(name) == TypeCustom` is used as the "unknown type" test, and `NewCustomType(..., TypeCustom, name)` is built inline. That also changes the resolved `TypeInfo` for every caller of `getCassandraLongType` (`frame.go:860`, `helpers.go:72`), not just vector elements. The type now carries a `custom` name where it was empty before. Nothing in the diff shows other callers were checked.

## Spec
1. **Low** — `marshal.go:1121-1145`, `vectorElemMinSize`: a zero-dimension inner vector returns 1, but its real minimum is 0 bytes when it is fixed-size. So `vector<vector<float,0>,N>` with a short payload is rejected as "do not fit". The PR says `dim < 1` is rejected elsewhere in #1093, so this is only reachable until that lands. The code comment says "would divide by zero" but not that the floor is deliberately over-strict.
2. **Low** — `marshal.go:1000-1002`: the guard skips `data == nil`, but an empty non-nil payload with `Dimensions > 0` now errors. The description says this is intended for short or empty payloads. I'm noting it as a behaviour change worth a release note, not a defect.
3. **Info** — the crash class is not fully closed. A variable-length element's vint length narrowing to a negative, and a nil `SubType` with `Dimensions > 0`, still reach `vectorFixedElemSize` and `Unmarshal` on `Scan`'s goroutine. The PR defers the first to #1106. The comment at `marshal.go:995-997` covers only the `Dimensions == 0` case.

**Summary:** Standards has 4 findings, all Low, worst being the Claude attribution line in the PR body. Spec has 3 findings, worst being the over-strict floor for zero-dimension inner vectors, which is Low. I found no correctness defects in the bound or the nil-type guard.
